game.title: Rise of the Tomb Raider
game.blurb: Action-adventure in which Lara Croft explores Siberia in search of a lost city, from Crystal Dynamics (PC port with Nixxes, Mac with Feral Interactive), released 2015-11-10. RAWG average playtime: 14 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Lara follows her father's research into the Siberian wilderness. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Tombs, Missions and Exploration
chapters.summary: Challenge Tombs, missions and challenges, Survival Caches, monoliths, languages, documents and relics, and 100 percent completion.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Crafting
chapters.summary: Stealth kills, bow shots, weapons and upgrades, crafting, skills and hunting.

chapters.title: Difficulty Runs
chapters.summary: Finishing on Survivor and Extreme Survivor, and fights after the ending.

chapters.title: Expeditions: Score Attack, Replay and Cards
chapters.summary: Score Attack medals, Replay challenges and collecting expedition cards.

chapters.title: Endurance Mode, Solo and Co-op
chapters.summary: Surviving the forest for days, artifacts, crypts and the co-op Endurance challenges.

chapters.title: Baba Yaga: The Temple of the Witch (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Wicked Vale, Nadia, the Dreamstinger and the Wraithskin outfit.

chapters.title: Blood Ties and Lara's Nightmare (DLC)
chapters.summary: Exploring Croft Manor, and fighting through it in the Nightmare.

chapters.title: Cold Darkness Awakened (DLC)
chapters.summary: Rescuing prisoners and a block of hidden challenges, placed by list position.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 391220)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Rise_of_the_Tomb_Raider
Fandom (tombraider.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://tombraider.fandom.com/wiki/Rise_of_the_Tomb_Raider
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); only a short Table of Contents subpage (about 700 characters) exists, so nothing was used. tombraider.fandom.com answers the API, with about 178 linked pages, including "Rise of the Tomb Raider: Baba Yaga: The Temple of the Witch", "Rise of the Tomb Raider: Blood Ties", "Rise of the Tomb Raider: Lara's Nightmare", "Rise of the Tomb Raider: Cold Darkness Awakened" and "Rise of the Tomb Raider: Endurance Mode"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's entry is the 2015 game (id 7689), not the 20 Year Celebration edition (id 1120). 19 of 143 Steam achievements are hidden. Baba Yaga, Blood Ties, Lara's Nightmare, Endurance and Cold Darkness achievements carry those prefixes in their descriptions and were placed by them; the nine hidden ones around "To the Rescue" (Cold Darkness Challenge, 104 to 113) were put in the Cold Darkness chapter by position. The other 10 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; "The Chosen Few" and "Quite A Tumble" are listed away from the story block and may not be story beats. "The Price of Truth" (finish on any difficulty) was put in the main story chapter.
